_comment: wallpapershome.com, described 2026-10-16 from the site as it answers from this machine.
ROBOTS: its robots.txt answers 403 to us (and to a browser UA), so nothing can be read from it.
What was checked instead: every url this file can produce is a public listing or a public file the
page itself links to, one request per page of 16 cards, min_interval_ms 3000 = 20 requests a minute
at one site, and nothing under /admin or /cgi is ever asked for.
WHY THIS FILE NEEDS THE `original` RULE: the listing only ever links the 400x225 card thumb and a
1280x720 pic_h file (measured: /images/pages/pic_h/29900.jpg is 1280x720, 172,000 bytes). The
full-size jpeg is written on the wallpaper's own page, and its name is NOT derivable from the
listing - the page slug and the file slug differ (…/wildflower-meadows-sunny-skies-garden-flowers-
29897.html names wildflower-meadows-wallpaper-3840x2160-flower-season-colorful-landscapes-29897.jpg).
So `original` runs one regex on that page and the download follows.
AND THE REFERER: that same file answers 403 to a bare request and 200 with the page as Referer
(measured 3,570,935 bytes, 3840x2160, with the app's own UA). Declaring `original` is what makes the
fetcher send the page as Referer on the way to the file.
PAGES: 16 cards a page, the pager is JS but each page links its neighbours as ?page=N-1..N+1, so
rolling_pages is true and 下一页 stops where the site stops answering. Categories that do not return
the 16-card layout were left out rather than guessed: /top/ and /daily/ answer 200 with 0 cards,
/quotes/ is a different layout with 10.
SEARCH: not probed. ask=false until someone reads the site's own search path.
user_agent: the site answers the app's own UA (200, same bytes as a Chrome UA), so none is declared.
The 4K rung is hardcoded in `original`; the site also publishes 2560x1440, 1920x1080 and two
portrait sizes, which is an option to add when the resolution filter learns to ask for one.
size: the card claims 3840x2160 because that is the rung `original` asks for - it is
the site's own top rung for a desktop, and it is what 入库 then writes into the package.
thumb needs its own field name: `$3` only expands as a whole field value, not inside a
template (writing "{homepage}$3" shipped the literal '$3' into the card).
params.page uses {page}, not {nextpage}: the bare /category/ page prints only a
`?page=1` link and 8 cards, while /category/?page=1 prints its neighbours and 16 -
with {nextpage} the first ask would have no neighbour to read and 下一页 would
never appear. 4kwallpapers needs the opposite (it 301s ?page=1 back to the plain
url), which is why both placeholders exist.
